ItemsPage.metadataDescription: Explore the family management items Rwanda Family helps organize, including money, contributions, projects, documents, reports, events, and members.
ItemsPage.title: Items for everyday family administration.
ItemsPage.description: Rwanda Family keeps the important parts of family management structured, private, and easy to review. Each item is designed for family roles, approvals, audit history, and mobile use.
ItemsPage.freeNote: The application is currently free to use. Rwanda Family does not sell private family data or use it for unrelated advertising, profiling, or external datasets.

items.title: Family money
items.description: Track income, expenses, categories, dates, statuses, creators, and approvals in one auditable place.

items.title: Contributions
items.description: Organize monthly, emergency, event, and project contributions with expected amounts, paid amounts, due dates, and member status.

items.title: Savings goals
items.description: Follow shared goals, target amounts, current progress, contribution history, and target dates.

items.title: Expense records
items.description: Submit, review, approve, reject, and pay expenses without losing the audit history behind each decision.

items.title: Projects
items.description: Manage family initiatives with budgets, timelines, updates, members, linked documents, and linked money records.

items.title: Documents
items.description: Keep receipts, agreements, certificates, reports, and family files with role-aware access rules.

items.title: Reports
items.description: Generate summaries from saved records for money movement, savings, debt, contribution, budget, and project activity.

items.title: Announcements
items.description: Publish notices, emergency updates, and pinned family messages so members can stay informed.

items.title: Events
items.description: Plan family events with dates, locations, RSVP status, reminders, and optional linked contributions.

items.title: Members
items.description: Invite members, approve access, assign roles, and keep sensitive actions visible only to permitted people.

PrivacyPage.metadataDescription: Read how Rwanda Family protects family data, limits data use, and avoids selling or reusing private records for unrelated purposes.
PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.description: Rwanda Family is built for private family administration. Family data should be protected, used only for the application, and kept inside the permissions of each family workspace.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Rwanda Family may collect account details, family membership details, family workspace records, financial records entered by permitted users, documents uploaded by users, device information, security logs, and support messages.

sections.title: How we use data
sections.body: We use data to run the application, authenticate users, enforce family permissions, keep records available, generate reports, send requested notifications, prevent abuse, improve reliability, and respond to support requests.

sections.title: What we do not do
sections.body: We do not sell personal data. We do not use private family financial records, documents, or member data for unrelated advertising, unrelated profiling, or external datasets.

sections.title: Limited operational access
sections.body: Private family data should only be accessed by authorized operational staff when needed for support requested by a user, security investigation, abuse prevention, legal compliance, or system maintenance. Access should be limited, accountable, and never for personal use.

sections.title: Family permissions
sections.body: Family owners and permitted leaders control who can join a family workspace and what members can see or do. The backend must enforce access rules for protected records.

sections.title: Retention and deletion
sections.body: Financial and permission-sensitive records may be retained for audit history. Where deletion is allowed, Rwanda Family should use safe deletion, soft deletion, or reversal records when auditability matters.

SafetyPage.metadataDescription: Learn how Rwanda Family keeps the application free, protects private family data, and limits access to sensitive records.
SafetyPage.title: Safety and Data Policy
SafetyPage.description: Rwanda Family should be safe for every family. The application is currently free to use, and private family data must not be sold, reused for unrelated purposes, or accessed casually.

protections.title: No unrelated use
protections.description: Private family records are for running Rwanda Family workflows, not for unrelated advertising, profiling, or resale.

protections.title: Permission-aware access
protections.description: Protected actions and records should be checked against family membership, role, and permissions on the server.

protections.title: Audit-friendly records
protections.description: Financial approvals, permission changes, exports, and sensitive activity should leave accountable history.

protections.title: Tenant boundary
protections.description: Family workspaces are designed as private tenant boundaries so one family cannot access another family's records.

protections.title: Sensitive data care
protections.description: Passwords, tokens, reset codes, MFA details, and private payment details must not be logged or exposed.

protections.title: Free access
protections.description: The application is currently free to use, so families can organize records without a subscription barrier.

TermsPage.metadataDescription: Read the Rwanda Family terms covering free use, user responsibilities, family owner responsibilities, and acceptable use.
TermsPage.title: Terms of Use
TermsPage.description: These terms explain how Rwanda Family should be used while it is offered as a free family management application.

sections.title: Free use
sections.body: Rwanda Family is currently free to use. If paid features are introduced later, users should receive clear notice before being asked to pay.

sections.title: User responsibility
sections.body: Users are responsible for entering accurate records, protecting login details, inviting only trusted members, and reviewing records before approval or reporting.

sections.title: Family owner responsibility
sections.body: Family owners manage the workspace, approve members, assign roles, and decide which information members can access according to family needs.

sections.title: Financial records
sections.body: Rwanda Family helps organize family records but does not create, invent, or approve financial activity on behalf of a family. Reports must be based on persisted records.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Users may not use Rwanda Family to upload harmful files, violate privacy, impersonate others, attack the service, bypass permissions, or store unlawful content.

sections.title: Service changes
sections.body: Features may change as the product improves. Privacy, security, and auditability remain core requirements for changes that affect family data.
